# Check exact preference strings against declared telemetry labels

The initial 1261 labels include mail.biff.alert.show_subjec, mail.mailnews.scroll_to_new_message and mail.prompt_purge_threshhold. Current collector and schema contain the corrected exact names. A static literal-set check found all 81 base mail names plus the 10 conditional-push names in the 91 declared labels, and all 15 Calendar names in its 15 labels. The conditional union is not a platform run or Glean cardinality test. This scoped string-fidelity lesson augments the existing label-declaration note rather than repeating it. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mail/metrics.yaml.
